sections.name: Toaster
sections.title: Toaster with theme and styles
sections.what: Creates the toast container, reads the current theme, and styles the toast and its buttons to match the app.
sections.why: Likely reason: toasts then look like other app surfaces in both light and dark mode.
sections.watch_out: The styles depend on the toast library's group class names, so changing the container class breaks them.

summary: Sets up the popup area that shows short messages such as saved or error alerts, styled to the app theme.
purpose: Gives the app one place to show toast messages.
why: Likely reason: it wraps a toast library and reads the theme so messages match light or dark mode.
how: Reads the current theme, defaulting to system, and passes it to the toast library along with a class name and style overrides for the toast, its description, and its action and cancel buttons. Other props pass through.
inputs: The theme from a theme hook, plus any props given to the component.
outputs: A toast container that shows messages.
risks: The theme comes from a theme provider in another file, so without one the theme falls back to system. The file uses React types without importing React, which can fail on some setups.
debug: If toasts have the wrong colours, check the theme provider wraps the app. If the component fails to load, check that the next-themes and sonner packages are installed.
